mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_metrics ( admin_dong_id, rental_type, house_type, avg_area, avg_deposit, avg_rent, transaction_count ) SELECT admin_dong_id, rental_type, house_type, ROUND(AVG(area), 2), CAST(ROUND(AVG(deposit_amount), 0) AS SIGNED), CAST(ROUND(AVG(monthly_rent_amount), 0) AS SIGNED), COUNT(*) FROM rental_transactions WHERE admin_dong_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY admin_dong_id, rental_type, house_type
